task: Making apple and almond butter oatmeal bowl
query: How do I make an apple and almond butter oatmeal bowl?

goal.title: Prepare oatmeal with warmed apple and nut butter
goal.description: Measure oats and water into a saucepan, heat them on the stove, wash and dice an apple, trim its skin from individual pieces and microwave the prepared fruit. Serve the cooked oats, add the warmed apple and nut butter, and stir together.
goal.final_state: A bowl contains stirred oatmeal with apple pieces and nut butter; the emptied saucepan and apple trimmings remain nearby.
procedure: Measure dry oats into the saucepan, fill a clear jug at the sink and add water.
Turn on and adjust the stove, briefly stir, and leave the oats heating.
Wash the apple, cut sections away from its core and dice them on the board.
Trim peel from individual apple chunks and collect the prepared pieces in a bowl.
Microwave the apple pieces and wait for the heating cycle.
Remove the apple, stir the oats until thickened and turn off the burner.
Scrape the cooked oats into a serving bowl, add apple and nut butter, and stir until combined.

phases.description: Dry oats are measured into a saucepan. Water is collected at the sink and poured in, the stove is switched on and adjusted, and the oats briefly stirred.
The pot is watched without hand contact, the burner is adjusted, and an apple is picked up and washed at the sink.
A knife cuts sections from around the apple core; the core is set aside and successive pieces are cut into smaller chunks on the board.
Individual apple chunks are held and pared with the knife. Skin trimmings stay on the board while prepared pieces are collected in a bowl.
The apple bowl is carried to the microwave, placed inside and heated while the person waits. The door is opened and the warmed bowl removed.
The oats are stirred, with a pause between stirring bouts. The burner is turned off and the saucepan tipped while a spoon scrapes the cooked oats into a bowl.
The warmed apple pieces are tipped into the oatmeal and the empty bowl set aside. Nut butter is spooned in, residue is scraped off utensils, and the bowl is repeatedly stirred.
